1: Allah ne apna Rasool ﷺ in mushrikeen ki taraf bheja, phir yeh apas mein kis cheez ke baare mein pooch rahe hain?
2: Yeh ek doosre se us bari khabar ke baare mein pooch rahe hain. Yeh wohi Quran hai jo un ke Rasool par utara gaya, aur jis mein dobara zinda hone ki khabar hai.
3: Yeh wohi Quran hai jis ke bayan mein woh ikhtilaf karte hain: kya yeh jaadu hai, ya sheri, ya kahanat, ya purane logon ke qisse?
4: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa woh dawa karte hain. Quran ko jhutlane wale apne is inkaar ka bura anjaam bahut jald jaan lenge.
5: Phir yeh baat un ke liye dobara zor de kar kahi jayegi.
6: Kya maine zameen ko un ke liye bichhone ki tarah hamwar nahin kiya, taake woh us par rehne ke qabil ho?
7: Aur kya maine us par pahaar khoonton ki tarah nahin gaare, taake woh hil na jaye?
8: Aur aey logon, maine tumhein mukhtalif qismon mein paida kiya: koi tum mein mard hai aur koi aurat.
9: Aur maine tumhari neend ko tumhari harakat ka anjaam banaya, taake tum aaram pa sako.
10: Aur maine raat ko us ki tareeki ke saath tumhare liye parda banaya, us libaas ki tarah jis se tum apna satar dhanpte ho.
11: Aur maine din ko kamane aur rizq talash karne ka maidan banaya.
12: Aur maine tumhare oopar saat mazboot aasman banaye, jo apni takhleeq mein kaamil hain.
13: Aur maine sooraj ko ek nihayat roshan aur garm chiraag banaya.
14: Aur maine aise baadal bheje jin ka khoob barasne ka waqt aa gaya tha.
15: Taake us paani se main mukhtalif qism ke ghalle aur khetiyan nikalun.
16: Aur aise baag nikalun jo apne darakhton ki shakhon ke qareeb hone ki wajah se ek doosre mein gunde hue hain.
17: Allah ne yeh niyamatein bayan ki, jo us ki qudrat ka saboot hain. Phir us ne dobara zinda hone aur qayamat ke din ka zikr kiya, kyunke jo in niyamaton ko paida karne par qadir hai, wohi murdon ko zinda kar ke un ka hisaab lene par bhi qadir hai. Woh farmata hai: beshak makhlooq ke darmiyan faisle ka din muqarrar hai, aur us ka waqt tay hai, jo badlega nahin.
18: Us din farishta doosri baar soor mein phoonkega, aur aey logon, tum giroh dar giroh haazir ho jaoge.
19: Aur aasman khul jayega; us mein khule darwazon jaise raaste ban jayenge.
20: Aur pahaaron ko chalaya jayega, yahan tak ke woh bikhri hui dhool ban jayenge aur sarab ki tarah dikhenge.
21: Beshak jahannum taak mein hai, ghaat lagaye baithi hai.
22: Zalimon ke liye woh laut kar jane ki jagah hai, jahan unhein lautaya jayega.
23: Us mein woh be-shumaar zamanon aur saalon tak rahenge.
24: Us mein woh na koi thandi hawa payenge jo unhein aag ki garmi se thanda kare, aur na koi aisa peene ki cheez chakhenge jis se woh lutf uthayein.
25: Woh sirf sakht garam paani chakhenge, aur jahannum walon ki behti hui peep.
26: Yeh badla us kufr aur gumrahi ke mutabiq hai jis par woh qayam thay.
27: Beshak duniya mein woh is baat se nahin darte thay ke Allah aakhirat mein un ka hisaab lega, kyunke woh dobara zinda hone par iman nahin laaye thay. Agar woh qayamat se darte, to Allah par iman laate aur neik aamaal karte.
28: Aur jo aayatein maine apne Rasool par utari thin, unhein unhon ne sakhti se jhutlaya.
29: Maine un ka har amal likh liya aur gin liya; woh sab un ke aamaal-naamon mein darj hai.
30: Aey hadd se barhne walon, ab is hamesha rehne wale azaab ko bhugto; main tumhein azaab par azaab ke siwa kuch na barhaunga.
31: Beshak jo log apne Rubb se darte hain, us ke hukmon ko poora karte hue aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hue, un ke liye kamiyabi ka ek maqam hai jis par woh kamiyab honge, aur woh jannat payenge jis ke woh talabgaar thay.
32: Woh baagon aur angoor ki belon se bhari hui hai.
33: Aur us mein hum-umr auratein hain.
34: Aur sharab se bhare hue paimane.
35: Jannat mein woh na koi jhooti baat sunenge aur na jhoot; aur na woh ek doosre se jhoot bolenge.
36: Yeh sab us ata mein se hoga jo Allah unhein apne karam aur fazl se dega, aur woh un ke liye kaafi hoga.
37: Wohi aasmanon, zameen aur un ke darmiyan ki har cheez ka Rubb hai; duniya aur aakhirat mein karam karne wala. Zameen aur aasman mein koi us se sawal nahin kar sakta, siwaye us soorat mein ke woh khud ijazat de.
38: Us din Jibreel (alaihis salaam) aur farishte saf bandh kar khare honge. Woh kisi ki sifarish ke liye baat na karenge, siwaye us ke jis ke liye Rehman ijazat de, aur jis ne seedhi baat kahi ho, yani Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawahi.
39: Jis din ka bayan tum se kiya gaya, us ke aane mein koi shak nahin. Pas jo us din Allah ke azaab se nijaat chahta hai, usey chahiye ke neik aamaal ke zariye us ki taraf raasta banaye, jin se us ka Rubb raazi ho.
40: Aey logon, maine tumhein ek aane wale azaab se daraya hai, jo us din aayega jab insan dekhega ke us ne duniya mein kaise aamaal aage bheje. Aur kafir, azaab se bachne ki khwahish karte hue, kahega: “Kaash main jaanwaron ki tarah mitti ho jata!” yeh us waqt hoga jab qayamat ke din un se kaha jayega: “Mitti ho jao.”
